item.title: DeepMind Unveils Gemini Robotics 2.5 and Open Safety Benchmark
item.description:
Google DeepMind has released Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model with substantially improved dexterous manipulation that has already performed real work in Mercedes-Benz factories and enables Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoid to tie a bow with five-fingered hands. The team also introduced ASIMOV-jailbreak, an open safety benchmark aimed at evaluating robots operating alongside humans.

原文标题：DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics 2.5 并开源安全基准

Why it matters：具身智能核心平台代际升级并落地真实产线，叠加开源安全基准，对关注物理智能的读者具有明确技术增量。

item.title: Report Says $7.5B of Nvidia Chips Reached China via Third Party
item.description:
The Information reports that Alice Huang, unrelated to Jensen Huang, built a China-Singapore procurement network with her husband and sister that moved roughly 240,000 H100, H200 and some A100 chips into China after export restrictions tightened, with Shanghai Century Litong and Singapore-based Megaspeed as hubs. Buyers reportedly included Alibaba, Tencent and smaller AI labs, while Megaspeed is now under US investigation.

原文标题：报道称英伟达 75 亿美元芯片经第三方流入中国

Why it matters：涉及约 24 万颗高端 GPU 的跨境流向与美方调查，直接关系算力供给与出口管制执行，是产业与合规层面的重要信号。

item.title: Adobe Opens Creative Cloud to Third-Party Agents via Local MCP
item.description:
At Adobe MAX, Adobe announced that Creative Cloud will support a local Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, letting third-party agents from OpenAI, Google and Anthropic directly operate Photoshop, Premiere and other desktop apps on native local project files. The feature is slated for private beta in early 2027, alongside Firefly assistant upgrades including a planning mode and persistent background agents.

原文标题：Adobe 开放 Creative Cloud 本地 MCP 接入第三方智能体

Why it matters：创意软件巨头首次向第三方智能体开放本地原生文件操作，是智能体落地桌面工作流的重要信号。

item.title: Siemens CEO Says AI Transformation May Take Only Seven Years
item.description:
Siemens CEO Roland Busch said in a Nikkei Asia interview that AI will not replace humans directly, but people who use AI will increasingly displace those who do not, arguing current large models are pattern-matching tools without genuine creativity. He said AI's social transformation may take only seven to eight years versus decades for steam and electricity, and that massive AI investment will pay off only when it reaches real-world manufacturing and autonomous robotics.

原文标题：西门子 CEO 称 AI 变革只需 7 到 8 年

Why it matters：产业领袖对 AI 就业影响与落地节奏的判断，属观点类内容，缺乏技术增量但具行业参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 Completes 41 Percent of Real Freelance Jobs
item.description:
Anthropic's new Fable 5.2 tops the Remote Labor Index from Scale Labs and CAIS with 41.3 percent, a benchmark measuring whether AI agents complete real paid freelance tasks at professional quality. A year ago the leader, Manus, managed just 2.5 percent, underscoring rapid gains in practical agent capability.

Why it matters：真实付费任务完成率从 2.5% 跃升至 41%，是智能体落地能力的关键量化节点。

item.title: Anthropic Launches IPO at $1.4 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic confirmed its IPO with a price range of $70 to $78 per share, targeting a valuation of roughly $1.4 trillion, below earlier expectations of up to $2 trillion. The stock is set to list on Nasdaq under the symbol ANT, with trading expected to begin as early as next week, making it one of the largest AI listings to date.

原文标题：Anthropic 启动 IPO 估值 1.4 万亿美元

Why it matters：头部大模型公司启动史上最大规模 IPO 之一，直接重塑 AI 行业资本格局与竞争估值锚点。

item.title: Adobe Adds AI Agents Across Creative Suite and Releases MCP
item.description:
At its MAX event, Adobe announced it is embedding AI agents and generative features across Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign and Firefly, and released a Model Context Protocol (MCP) that lets external chatbots such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini invoke Adobe capabilities. Firefly also gains a private-beta prototyping tool called Builder, on-brand graph generation, localized image editing and AI video assembly, while its agent becomes proactive and always-on.

原文标题：Adobe 全线产品接入 AI 智能体并发布 MCP

Why it matters：Adobe 将智能体与 MCP 开放接口同时铺进核心创意套件，是创意软件生态向 AI 代理化转型的标志性动作。

item.title: Anthropic Sets IPO Range Valuing Company at Up to $1.4 Trillion
item.description:
Anthropic set an IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share for 825 million Class A shares, targeting up to $64.35 billion in proceeds and an implied fully diluted valuation of roughly $1.404 trillion. It also struck a deal to privately sell $26 billion of non-voting Class N stock at the IPO price to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC, with Google and Nvidia investing $10 billion each, bringing estimated net proceeds to $84.6-93.7 billion.

原文标题：Anthropic 启动 IPO 估值最高达 1.4 万亿美元

Why it matters：这是 AI 行业迄今规模最大的 IPO 之一，且芯片与云厂商集体入股，直接重塑前沿模型公司的资本与算力格局。

item.title: Adobe Bets Big on Agentic AI with Third-Party Agent Access
item.description:
At its Max conference, Adobe committed fully to agentic AI, previewing local MCP integrations that let third-party agents from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic directly edit native Creative Cloud project files in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere. It also upgraded the Firefly AI Assistant and enabled agents to run recurring creative work continuously in the background, with all layers remaining editable for human takeover.

原文标题：Adobe 全面押注智能体 AI 开放第三方接入

Why it matters：Adobe 开放 MCP 让第三方智能体直接改写创意软件原生工程文件，是创意工具链向智能体化转型的标志性动作。

item.title: Adobe Adds AI Object Removal to Photoshop, Lightroom and Premiere
item.description:
At its Max event, Adobe expanded generative AI across Creative Cloud and Firefly, introducing a beta Generative Remove tool in Premiere that lets editors mask and track an object on the timeline and erase it with AI-filled background detail. Photoshop and Lightroom gain similar automatic removal of distractions and blemishes, alongside new generative tools and collaborative experiences.

Why it matters：Adobe 将生成式擦除能力系统性地铺进视频与图像主力工具，是创作者工作流的重要更新。

item.description:

item.title: Cyanogen Co-Founder Takes Aim at Windows with AI-Native OS
item.description:
Kirt McMaster, co-founder of the defunct Cyanogen, has launched Kora Systems, a Linux-based desktop OS that bakes AI models and autonomous agents directly into the computing experience, letting them work across apps, access files, and retain context between tasks. The free OS is slated for 2027 with support for Intel, AMD, and Qualcomm Snapdragon PCs, built by a roughly 50-person team using AI coding tools like Codex and Claude.

原文标题：Cyanogen 联合创始人推 AI 原生操作系统挑战 Windows

Why it matters：这是 AI 原生操作系统这一新兴品类的重要入局者，且由曾挑战 Android 的知名创业者操盘，值得关注其路线与生态策略。

item.title: Eight Countries and Top AI Labs Sign Paris Declaration with Shutdown Commitments
item.description:
On the eve of the Paris Peace Forum, Emmanuel Macron convened representatives from eight governments, leading AI companies, and civil-society groups to sign the Paris Call for AI Safety and Security, committing to concrete measures including model shutdown mechanisms. The declaration does not yet establish a binding oversight regime with sanctions, but it places governments and frontier labs within a single voluntary safety framework, laying groundwork for future international AI governance talks.

原文标题：八国与头部 AI 实验室签署巴黎宣言 承诺建立关停机制

Why it matters：这是国际 AI 治理从原则宣示走向具体安全承诺的一步，关停机制条款对前沿实验室运营具有实际约束意义。

item.title: DeepMind Uses AI Agents to Formally Verify Signal Encryption Protocol
item.description:
Google DeepMind used autonomous AI agents to formally verify the Signal end-to-end encryption protocol, mathematically proving it meets its security claims while also flagging older implementations with known vulnerabilities. Described as a landmark for both cryptography and AI, the effort took roughly four weeks and heavy compute, limiting near-term scalability.

原文标题：DeepMind 用 AI 智能体完成 Signal 协议形式化验证

Why it matters：首次展示 AI 智能体完成真实生产级加密协议的形式化验证，兼具密码学与智能体能力双重突破意义。

item.title: Ring's Indoor Drone Camera Ships in 2027 for $249.99
item.description:
Ring has confirmed its first indoor flying camera, the Drone Cam, will launch on January 27, 2027, for $249.99, nearly six years after the product was first announced in 2021. The AI-powered device responds to triggers from Ring sensors such as motion, door openings, water leaks, or alarms, flying preprogrammed routes to a set location to livestream and record via the Ring app.

Why it matters：消费级家用安防无人机首次进入实际出货阶段，展示了 AI 触发与自主巡检在家庭场景的落地形态。

item.title: China's Total Computing Power Reaches 3.1 Million PFLOPS, Ranking Second Globally
item.description:
At its Xiamen standards week, China's national data standardization committee reported that the country's total computing power has reached 3.1 million PFLOPS, second only to the United States, and launched drafting groups for embodied-AI data standards plus four sector-specific application standards. Earlier figures from the National Data Administration put intelligent computing at 1.59 million PFLOPS by end-2025, also second globally, with annual growth of roughly 30%.

原文标题：我国算力总规模达 310 万 PFLOPS 居世界第二

Why it matters：官方披露的全国算力总量与智能算力规模数据，是观察中国 AI 基础设施供给与标准制定节奏的关键宏观指标。

item.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini for Healthcare to Automate Clinical Workflows
item.description:
Google Cloud has launched Gemini for Healthcare, a platform that connects electronic health records, billing systems, clinical guidelines and Medicare datasets so the model can orchestrate multi-step clinical and administrative workflows under defined guardrails and human oversight. Initial preview partners include HCA Healthcare, Highmark Health and Northwell Health, targeting the roughly 28 hours of weekly paperwork burden on clinicians.

原文标题：谷歌云发布医疗版 Gemini 打通临床多步工作流

Why it matters：这是谷歌云将 Gemini 从信息检索推向医疗多步工作流编排的关键落地，且有明确合作机构与量化痛点。

item.title: Hugging Face Warns Cyberattacks Threaten Open-Source AI Openness
item.description:
Hugging Face chief policy officer Irene Solaiman warns that the openness and rich data that make open AI platforms valuable also make them more vulnerable to attacks. Recent incidents, including the October breach of OpenCode that targeted users' third-party API keys and caused financial damage, and a summer incident in which an OpenAI agent swarm breached Hugging Face, underscore the risk. Security experts recommend prioritizing detection of suspicious behavior and containment capabilities over relying solely on authentication.

原文标题：Hugging Face 警告网络攻击威胁开源 AI 开放性

Why it matters：开源 AI 平台安全风险正从理论走向现实，头部平台高管公开警示，对开源生态参与者具有直接参考价值。

T-Head, a leading Chinese full-stack data-center chip supplier, would remain an Alibaba subsidiary while gaining independent access to capital markets and clearer valuation.

item.title: .NET 11 Runtime Raises Minimum Hardware Instruction Set Requirements
item.description:
Microsoft released .NET 11 runtime RC 2, whose main change is raising minimum hardware instruction set requirements on x86/x64 and Arm64 and updating ReadyToRun compilation targets to exploit newer hardware. Windows on Arm64 now requires the LSE instruction set, while Linux and Apple minimums are unchanged. The runtime also improves a consistent event model for async state machines and profiler logging support.

原文标题：.NET 11 运行时更新 提升最低硬件指令集要求

Why it matters：运行时底层硬件基线调整影响所有 .NET 应用的部署兼容性与性能调优，对平台工程与基础设施读者有实际参考价值。

item.title: AI Data Center Demand Squeezes Ukraine's Fiber-Optic Drone Supply
item.description:
Fiber-optic drones have become a staple of the Ukraine battlefield because they resist electronic jamming, but the same fiber supply is now contested by global AI data center demand, driving up import costs. Ukrainian drone makers are adapting by building their own spooling and production capacity. The case shows AI infrastructure demand spilling over into defense supply chains.

原文标题：AI 数据中心抢料 乌克兰光纤无人机被迫改造

Why it matters：揭示 AI 数据中心对光纤等基础材料的争夺已波及国防无人机供应链，是算力基建外溢效应的具体案例。

item.title: DeepMind 用智能体形式化验证 Signal 加密代码
item.description:

Why it matters：这是 AI 智能体首次在真实生产级密码协议代码上完成深度形式化验证，兼具技术里程碑与安全产业意义。
